free_tier_limits: No free tier; API access requires an active Meetup Pro subscription and approval.
rate_limits: Official sources conflict: the GraphQL guide states 500 query points per 60 seconds; the Help Center says there is no strict automatic request cap and usage is monitored.
example_request: curl -X POST 'https://api.meetup.com/gql-ext' -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"query":"query { self { id name } }"}'
resolution_notes: base_url: replace with https://api.meetup.com/gql-ext (https://www.meetup.com/graphql/guide/). free_tier=false; free_tier_limits=no free tier, active Pro and approval required (https://help.meetup.com/hc/en-us/articles/41453576628749-How-can-I-get-access-to-Meetup-s-API). rate_limits: guide says 500 points/60s; Help Center says no strict automatic cap and usage is monitored (https://www.meetup.com/graphql/guide/; https://help.meetup.com/hc/en-us/articles/41467300722061-Are-there-rate-limits-when-using-Meetup-s-API). example: use documented GraphQL POST (https://www.meetup.com/graphql/guide/).
